title: [3.1.0.3] Future insulin activity projection line disappears
symptom: The yellow dashed insulin projection line into the future disappears sometimes, particularly near the next round hour. It did not happen with v. 2.8.2.1.
cause: The forecast activity is only shown until the next hour in the future. If you are just before a new hour (e.g., 13:58) or the graph is not fully updated (e.g., 14:04), the forecast activity is not visible.
fix: The issue was fixed by a commit referenced in the thread: https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/1f1a2eae48564779a9f88363749f6d58fa8441f1
evidence_quote: I think you only have only forecast for activity until. the next hour in future. If you are just before a new hour (13h58) or graph is still not fully updated (14h04), you don't see the forecast activity, and a bit later, you see it up to next hour (15h in your screenshots)...
